2.2. RECIPIENT agrees to hold in confidence any and all Confidential Information disclosed, and further agrees not to disclose Confidential Information to third parties without the prior written permission of DISCLOSING PARTY and restrict the use of Confidential Information to the Purpose (and not to use it for any other purpose).

Neither the execution of this Agreement nor the furnishing or disclosing of any Confidential Information hereunder shall be construed as an assignment or transfer, either expressly or by implication, estoppel or otherwise, or as granting any express or implied rights or license to the RECIPIENT to, or under any patents, patent applications, inventions, design rights, copyrights, trademarks, trade secret information, or other intellectual and/or industrial property right of any kind now or hereafter owned by or controlled or possessed by DISCLOSING PARTY.
